score._seed_weight_note: a pair with a seed counts this many times in the fit, so the deck stays around the seeds. Measured in docs/phase-4-sample-decks.md sec. 7
score._weak_factor_note: the part of its weight that a pair keeps when the newest owner answer is 'Yes, but weak'. The pair stays a link. Measured in docs/schema-v20-results.md sec. 20
score._rate_weight_note: the fit that 1 mana of card rate adds when the goal has use_rate. Provisional: 10% of 0.46, the median best fit of the replay goals, because 20% replaced the links. The rate has passed no check yet, so the switch is off by default. Measured in docs/card-rate-results.md, Task 5
score._owner_link_weight_note: the weight of an owner link that an apply session adds (link review design sec. 8). Provisional: the median weight of all confirmed + pairs of build 36. A weak owner link keeps weak_factor of it

copies._seed_min_note: the copies that each seed keeps; above this a seed has the copies of its third by fit, as any other card

quotas._quota_card_copies_note: the copies that a quota counts for one card: the lowest copies of the copies rule, because the copies come after the quota fill

mana._start_lands_note: the land count of the first loop only; the loop then sets it
mana._cards_seen_note: on the play: the top 6 + T cards on turn T

export._name_form_note: full = the name in the cards table; front = the name of face 0. A key of a layout overrides the default. The first import decides (design sec. 10).
